limitations: Tests use genuine local SQLite/Web Crypto and synthetic keys/contacts; they do not establish actual D1 runtime acceptance.
Initial fingerprint registration requires an empty paused database. Existing data without a registry cannot silently adopt replacement keys.
Irrecoverable contact encryption keys cannot be reconstructed by re-authentication; preserve evidence and keep affected services gated.
Subsequent key rotations wait for preceding retained read versions to retire; existing old deadlines cannot be extended.
Retirement inspection does not delete Worker secrets or authorize an external change.
Native device storage, real provider/template behavior, backup custody and named release authorization remain separate evidence.
